summary: Re-ran full pytest suite (27/27 PASS) after Resend integration swap and gallery cleanup. Verified Resend end-to-end: welcome + confirmation emails delivered to verified address reachbiraajo@gmail.com (real Resend IDs in backend logs). Frontend smoke-tested all 3 new pages, the rebuilt Navbar (incl. dropdown + mobile), hash-link navigation from a subpage, gallery purity (7 customer-assets, 0 unsplash) and Barsaat Reserve → EventRegistrationModal flow.

minor.issue: Resend returns 4xx for non-verified recipients in test mode, logged as [EMAIL FAIL] ERROR. Non-blocking (registration still succeeds). Expected per Resend dev-mode contract; will resolve once a domain is verified at resend.com/domains. Consider downgrading log level to WARNING to avoid alarming the dashboard.

action_items: Optional: lower [EMAIL FAIL] log severity to WARNING (Resend test-mode rejections of non-verified recipients are expected).

Optional: replace/clean the leftover seed upcoming event (title='T', date 2030-01-01) so the Barsaat page's hero card and the registration modal title show a meaningful name. Cosmetic only — Barsaat page renders correctly regardless.
critical_code_review_comments: send_welcome_email/send_confirmation_email are fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task (server.py register_event and payment-screenshot endpoints) — good, no request blocking on Resend latency.
Resend errors are caught inside _send_email and logged; registration is never failed by an email-send error. Verified by suite still passing 27/27.
Navbar.useHashHref correctly prefixes hash links with '/' when not on the landing route — confirmed by clicking nav-menu from /about-the-chef and landing on /#menu.

Barsaat page uses generic 'first upcoming event' (api.get('/events?upcoming=true').[0]) as a fallback when nothing matches /barsaat|monsoon/i. This is fine, but if multiple events go live, the page may show an unrelated event. Consider tagging the Barsaat event explicitly with tag='Barsaat'.

EventRegistrationModal does not set role='dialog'/aria-modal on the outermost wrapper. Has data-testid='event-registration-modal' so tests work, but adding ARIA roles would help accessibility / focus trap libraries.
Gallery endpoint cleanup correctly persisted: 7 docs, all customer-assets.emergentagent.com, zero unsplash. Verified at both API and rendered DOM.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_biraajo_api.py (test_gallery_seeded relaxed >=10 → >=7 and added 'no unsplash' assertion to match new content contract)
test_credentials: Admin reachbiraajo@gmail.com / Biraajo@2026 — working. Resend verified-sender = reachbiraajo@gmail.com (dev mode).
seed_data_creation: Tests create/teardown their own ephemeral events. Manual VERIFY_EMAIL event created during email verification was deleted. One pre-existing leftover upcoming event with title='T' (date 2030-01-01) still in DB from earlier iterations — cosmetic only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest source-of-truth at /app/backend/tests/test_biraajo_api.py — 27/27 green this iteration. Resend integration is REAL (no longer stubbed). In dev mode, Resend only delivers to verified address reachbiraajo@gmail.com; all other addresses return 4xx and surface as [EMAIL FAIL] ERROR in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log — expected, do not treat as bug. Verified-recipient flow logs [EMAIL SENT] id=<uuid>. New routes /about-the-chef, /supper-club/naani-ghar, /supper-club/barsaat are all reachable, render, and Barsaat → EventRegistrationModal works. Navbar has data-testids: nav-story, nav-about-chef, nav-experiences, nav-events-toggle (+ nav-events-all/barsaat/naani-ghar inside dropdown), nav-menu, nav-gallery, nav-contact, plus mobile-* variants.
rca of the issue: N/A — no new bugs introduced. The two transient frontend-test 'failures' in the first Playwright pass were script-ordering issues, not product bugs: (a) clicking nav-events-toggle a second time toggles the dropdown CLOSED, so the subsequent Naani Ghar click timed out — verified separately via direct URL that the page works; (b) the EventRegistrationModal uses data-testid='event-registration-modal' rather than role='dialog', so my initial role-based selector returned false negatives — re-test with the testid selector confirmed the modal opens, renders 3-step stepper, populates form, and shows Veg ₹2,200 / Non-Veg ₹2,500.
